callback_bridge: NonlinearSystem.C registers its residual_object to ComputeResidualFunctor. Provided no residual-skipping failure is set, this functor passes the PETSc-supplied current solution and residual through FEProblemBase::computeResidualSys; it toggles the computing flag without advancing time/history. The already pinned FEProblemBase/ADKernel/NonlinearSystemBase chain performs current-solution physical reaction refresh.
failure_limit: A function-domain error or skipped residual is not evidence of refreshed saved reactions and must fail the subsequent native/capture/assessment gate.
profile_unchanged: Explicit -snes_monitor plus -snes_norm_schedule always; preonly/lu unchanged. No -snes_ksp_ew, tolerance relaxation or claim of original Newton convergence.
